description: Everything SDK: the IPC client DLL (Everything64.dll) for the Everything search engine.
notes: The Everything SDK is NOT part of the Everything installer; this package only ships the client DLLs (dll\Everything64.dll) and the C header/source.
DoRun's FILE_SEARCH_ENABLED feature needs this DLL and Everything.exe running in the background.

Upstream publishes no version number for Everything-SDK.zip, so this manifest uses the DLL's link date and has no checkver/autoupdate hook. Bump `version`/`hash` by hand when voidtools republishes the zip.
